notes: FDA-V3.1 adds explicit statistics, CMC/product-quality, and facility/inspection hard-gate subchecks.
This is a decision-architecture baseline, not a validated accuracy claim.
Trading variables such as price, market cap, momentum, short interest, IV, financing and ownership are prohibited from the FDA probability calculation.
Thresholds and weights must be calibrated only on decision-safe historical evidence and then frozen prospectively.
Unknown critical public evidence remains REVIEW rather than being assumed to pass.

statistics.note: A failed pivotal primary endpoint or invalid multiplicity control can block an approval call; uncertainty remains REVIEW.

cmc.note: CMC is not allowed to be averaged away by strong efficacy.

review_if: open relevant Form 483 without verified remediation
facility.note: A Form 483 alone is not an automatic CRL; unresolved critical inspection evidence blocks an approval call.
